title: MeshBooleanNode — CSG union/difference/intersect
description: Implement a mesh_boolean DSL node equivalent to Blender's GeometryNodeMeshBoolean. Performs constructive solid geometry (CSG) operations: UNION (combine two meshes), DIFFERENCE (subtract mesh B from A), INTERSECT (keep only overlapping volume). This is essential for collar blockers, cutouts, combining armor pieces, and any geometry that needs additive/subtractive modeling. Without this node, agents cannot create holes, trim geometry, or combine complex shapes. Reference: Blender-Procedural-Human armor/blocker/collar workflows.
definition-of-done:
1. New MeshBooleanNode class in ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/nodes/geometry/ with @MeshNodeAnnotation id 'mesh_boolean'
2. Input ports: mesh_a (MeshValue), mesh_b (MeshValue), operation (StringField: 'UNION', 'DIFFERENCE', 'INTERSECT')
3. Output port: geometry (MeshValue) containing the result mesh
4. Implements BSP-tree or plane-splitting CSG algorithm
5. Handles non-manifold edge cases gracefully (return mesh_a unchanged if boolean fails)
6. Registered in MeshNodeRegistry and usable in .dsl files
testing-plan:
1. Unit test: UNION of two overlapping cubes — verify combined mesh is watertight
2. Unit test: DIFFERENCE cube minus sphere — verify hole created
3. Unit test: INTERSECT two overlapping cubes — verify result is smaller than either input
4. DSL integration: write a test DSL using mesh_boolean, validate with ValidateDsl
5. Mesh probe: verify result bounding boxes are correct for each operation
